evidence.name: Screen field: Gap between choices
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Gap between choices" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Gap between choices
sections.description: The spacing between adjacent choices — a vertical gap in lists, the gap between cells in grids. Around 8–12px keeps items clearly separate and easy to tap without wasting space. Increase it for a more airy feel, or decrease it to fit more options above the fold.
